entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Lutung Kasarung is a Sundanese folktale from Indonesia. Set in the Pasir Batang Kingdom, it tells the tale of a magical lutung who helped a beautiful princess, Purbasari Ayuwangi, when her older sister attempted to rob her of her status as crown princess. The story is from an old Sundanese pantun. Lutung Kasarung is a legend from Asia. Classified as Tier E (Oral Tradition) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
